chapter: Royal Roost, Birdland and Three O'Clock High
title: Tadd Dameron's band with guitar lead; 'Focus' and 'John's Delight'
summary: Dameron wrote guitar lead parts for Collins; the recordings, including 'Focus' and Collins's 'John's Delight,' won a record of the year award.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Yeah, I worked there with Tad Dameron's band. Thank you for mentioning that. I worked above with Tad, and he wanted -- he had an idea that he wanted a guitar lead on all of his -- most of his arrangements. So he wrote quite a few things and on top of all the voicings there would be the guitar. And as a matter of fact we did quite a few recordings with this, and one of the records won an award for the record of the year. It was called Focus and John's Delight, which I wrote.
Those were recorded on what label? (Inaudible).
I think it was Capitol. I'm sure it was, because I -- I'm sure it was Capitol because the producer of that record, or the A&R man or the engineer was Pete Rugolo.
That was record of the year in what roll? (Inaudible).
